name: Skill Auto-Create
description: After N interesting tool calls in a session, prompts the agent to create a reusable Skill file capturing the workflow pattern.

toolCallThreshold.description: Min interesting tool calls before triggering skill creation prompt (default: 5)

interestingTools.description: Tool names considered 'interesting' for skill extraction (default: bash, computer, write_file, etc.)

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Enable automatic skill creation prompts after complex sessions

toolCallThreshold.label: Tool Call Threshold
toolCallThreshold.help: Minimum interesting tool calls before prompting skill creation (default: 5)

maxPerSession.label: Max Per Session
maxPerSession.help: Maximum skill creation prompts per session (default: 1)

interestingTools.label: Interesting Tools
interestingTools.help: Tool names to count toward the threshold (default: bash, computer, write_file, create_file, edit_file, run_terminal_cmd)

skillsDir.label: Skills Directory
skillsDir.help: Where to save auto-created skill files (default: ~/.openclaw/skills/auto-created)
